text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Bank reports a net profit rise in 1996 of 22.8 percent to 31.3 million dinars ($104.7 million).
- No changes among Health Ministry officials, Minister Anwar al-Nouri says.
- Some 64 lawsuits were brought against local newspapers in 1996.
- Kuwait's fast food market worth 45 million dinars ($150.5 million), industry executive says. Kuwait has a population of about two million.
- Kuwait Finance House sets up 50 million pound ($83.6 million) real estate portfolio in Britain.
- Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah says government keen on protecting public funds.
- Parliament turns up heat over government-owned Kuwait Oil Tanker Company (KOTC) fraud scandal.
